answer: To enter the earning set, a new agent locks a refundable uniqueness bond for three epochs. While the bond is frozen, the network sends unpredictable liveness probes; only the claimed runtime can return a signed signal bound to a single hardware key and process tree. Auditors compare replies, clocks, and funding paths. When several keys share a host or a lockstep cadence, that cluster is posted as a public fable and every colliding bond is slashed together. Full issuance waits until a crystal of distinct, non-clustered attestations has formed, so farms pay per head and still fail uniqueness.
